findings.subject: C:
findings.message: Fixed volume has critically low free capacity.
BIOS release date is at least five years old; review manufacturer guidance.
Inventory probe failed; assessment coverage is incomplete.

guidance.explanation: Available capacity is below both of RigPilot's critical thresholds.

next_steps.text: Confirm that important data is protected before making storage changes.
Avoid unnecessary large new writes while capacity remains critically low.

guidance.explanation: The reported BIOS release date is at least five complete calendar years old; age alone does not establish a vulnerability.

next_steps.text: Review the system manufacturer's official guidance for the exact system.
Do not install firmware solely because of this finding, and do not select a BIOS version without verified manufacturer guidance.

guidance.explanation: This inventory check did not complete successfully, so related assessment coverage is incomplete.

next_steps.text: Repeat the assessment once to determine whether the failure persists.
If it persists, note which check was affected and consult qualified support; do not infer a hardware fault from this finding alone.

guidance.explanation: The optional NVIDIA inventory check was unavailable; this does not indicate a GPU problem.

next_steps.text: No action is required when NVIDIA hardware is not expected.
If NVIDIA coverage is expected, verify that supported NVIDIA hardware and locally installed management tooling are available.
